statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-62900 (GHSA-23fw-v26w-5fgq) is a .NET information disclosure issue in Source Link (Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git): improper removal of sensitive information before storage or transfer lets an unauthorized attacker disclose information over a network. For the .NET 10 SDK 10.0.1xx band, Microsoft lists both at 10.0.102 through 10.0.110 as affected and 10.0.111, shipped with SDK 10.0.111 and .NET 10.0.11, as fixed (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-23fw-v26w-5fgq, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/435, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.11/10.0.11.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git.dll and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git.dll are in the Source Link SDKs of the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap and in the Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git nupkg files in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts, and every copy carries the version of the build's SDK as its product version: 10.0.102 to 10.0.110 in 10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.10-r0, then 10.0.113, 10.0.114 and 10.0.115 in 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0; no 10.0.11 or 10.0.12 build was published for Alpine 3.23. In the nupkg files of dotnet10-runtime-artifacts, the copies in the x86_64 10.0.13-r0 package contain the upstream change that removes the user name and password from repository URLs (the NormalizeUrlImpl method in Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git) and rejects the old Azure Repos SSH URL format that used the connection user name (the RemoteUrlFormatNoLongerSupported message in Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git), and the 10.0.10-r0 copies contain neither. The range ends at 10.0.13-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-62900 (GHSA-23fw-v26w-5fgq) is an information disclosure issue in the Source Link build tasks Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git, which did not remove sensitive information before storing or transferring it. For .NET 8, Microsoft ships these tasks inside the SDK with SDK-specific prerelease versions and lists the fix as SDK 8.0.130, released with .NET 8.0.30 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-23fw-v26w-5fgq, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.30/8.0.30.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold. The tasks ship in the .NET SDK held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap and as Source Link nupkg files in dotnet8-runtime-artifacts. 8.0.23-r0 to 8.0.29-r0 hold SDK 8.0.123 to 8.0.129, whose Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git are 8.0.0-beta.23615.1 (built from Source Link commit 94eaac3 of December 2023). 8.0.31-r0, the next published build, holds SDK 8.0.131 with 8.0.0-beta.26351.4 (built in July 2026), and later builds hold SDK 8.0.132 to 8.0.134 with 8.0.0-beta.26417.2. There is no 8.0.30 build. The range ends at 8.0.31-r0 because it is the first published build with the fixed SDK.

CVE-2026-62900 (GHSA-23fw-v26w-5fgq) is a .NET information disclosure issue in Source Link (Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git): improper removal of sensitive information before storage or transfer lets an unauthorized attacker disclose information over a network. Microsoft says the copies used by the .NET 9 SDK are fixed in SDK 9.0.120 (released with .NET 9.0.19) and SDK 9.0.317 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-23fw-v26w-5fgq, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.19/9.0.19.md). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. No 9.0.19 build was published; the build after 9.0.18-r0 is 9.0.20-r0, which carries SDK 9.0.121. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold. Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git.dll and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git.dll are in the Source Link SDKs of the .NET SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap and in the matching nupkg files in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts. Every copy of both assemblies is Source Link 9.0.0-beta.25564.5 in 9.0.12-r0 to 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.0-beta.26351.3 in 9.0.20-r0, and 9.0.0-beta.26417.3 from 9.0.21-r0 on, on both architectures. The 9.0.20-r0 copies in the x86_64 dotnet9-runtime-artifacts nupkg files contain the upstream change that removes the user name and password from repository URLs (the NormalizeUrlImpl method in Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git) and rejects the old Azure Repos SSH URL format that used the connection user name (the RemoteUrlFormatNoLongerSupported message in Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git); the 9.0.18-r0 copies, the same Source Link version as every earlier build, contain neither. The range ends at 9.0.20-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
